search_text: published ZDI-15-041 ZDI-CAN-2339 Samsung Security Manager ActiveMQ Broker Service DELETE Method Denial of Service Vulnerability 2015-02-10 CVE-2015-1499 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2015-1499 8.5 ['Samsung'] ['Security Manager'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to delete files of their choosing from systems running vulnerable installations of Samsung Security Manager. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the ActiveMQ Broker service that is installed as part of this product. By issuing an HTTP DELETE request, an attacker can delete files that reside on the server. The attacker may choose to delete critical files, rendering the server unusable. Samsung has issued the following update to resolve this issue: SSM 1.31 or higher ( http://www.samsungsecurity.com/swdown/download.asp ) ['2014-07-28 - Vulnerability reported to vendor', '2015-02-10 - Coordinated public release of advisory'] Andrea Micalizzi (rgod) https://www.zerodayinitiative.com/advisories/ZDI-15-041/
title: Samsung Security Manager ActiveMQ Broker Service DELETE Method Denial of Service Vulnerability
